# MM-P3-L2-HT03-S3 Calibration checks - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-HT03

## Scope
This document defines calibration check steps for sensors and timing on Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03). Checks cover timing verification, sensor functional confirmation, and lubrication verification required to support heat treat process control. See related change history and baseline procedures in ECN-2026-017 and MM-P3-L2-HT03. Refer to SB-1041 for safety barriers and lockout-tagout supplements.

## Tools
- Calibrated timing indicator compatible with furnace control outputs.  
- Multimeter for continuity and signal verification.  
- Thermal sensor simulator or appropriate simulator per MM-P3-L2-HT03.  
- Manufacturer-approved lubricant: CFW-LUB-159.  
- Standard PPE per SB-1041.

## Procedure
1. Secure furnace per SB-1041 and verify lockout-tagout.  
2. Power control cabinet to calibration mode as directed in MM-P3-L2-HT03.  
3. Using the timing indicator, trigger the control output that initiates quench sequence. Record the measured delay between command and quench valve actuation.  
4. Compare measured delay to the allowed quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03). If measured delay exceeds the quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 13 seconds, follow the fault escalation steps in ECN-2026-017.  
5. Verify sensor outputs using the thermal sensor simulator; confirm reading stability and range per MM-P3-L2-HT03.  
6. Inspect and, if required by wear indicators, apply lubricant CFW-LUB-159 to specified mechanical linkages following manufacturer guidance. Document lubricant application in maintenance log.

## Acceptance criteria
- Timing check: recorded quench delay must be less than or equal to the quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 13 seconds.  
- All monitored sensors return stable readings within expected outputs documented in MM-P3-L2-HT03.  
- Lubrication applied as required using CFW-LUB-159 and logged.  
- Any failure or deviation triggers corrective actions per ECN-2026-017 and locks the equipment out per SB-1041 until resolved.
